A Sprinkle of Recklessness.description: An ally's helpful skills are cheaper and grant Elemental Essence when used; an enemy's Harmful skills cost more.

A Tale of Joy and Wonder.description: For two turns, Keeper's allies gain Elemental Essence whenever they use a new skill.

Acceleration Serum.description: A ticking dose that detonates for 40 affliction damage after 3 turns.

Acted.description: Marks that Gommar has already taken an action this turn.

Aerie Essence Override.description: While her starting Shield holds, Syl always triggers Two as One when she uses a skill, even acting alone.

Apprenticeborn Pathogen.description: Dennis's spreading infection: it burns you now, saps your damage next turn, then stuns you after.

Arcadia, Enraged.description: While Enraged, Arcadia's Thorn Prick is free and Enhanced, and every enemy burns for 5 each turn.

Arcadian Advancement.description: Permanently extends the duration of Titania's effects — each stack makes them last one additional turn.

Arcadian Target.description: Singled out and marked as a target for a hero's follow-up attack.

Banner of Consecration.description: For 2 turns, anyone who damages Taryn or his allies takes 10 damage in return.

Banner of Harmony.description: The enemy's Harmful skills reflect back onto Taryn, and damaging his allies leaves them open to double Inspiring Thrust damage.

Blackened Wounds.description: Wounds that won't close — all incoming healing is ignored while marked.

Blessed Leylines.description: Permanently receives 5 more healing from all sources.

Blood in the Water.description: A reservoir of stored damage that Run Red empties to strike far harder.

Bloodrose Offering.description: If this ally dies this turn, Maggie heals 10 HP for each Curse of Thorns stack she holds.

Bog Witch's Bargain.description: Use a new skill to take 35 Affliction and permanently ignore non-damage effects, or stay idle and be stunned.

Boon: Save Your Friends.description: This Hero's next Helpful skill heals its targets 15 HP and makes them Invulnerable for a turn.

Bottled Flame.description: While Pyrrha holds it, damaging an enemy adds lingering Affliction damage.

Bounty.description: Shattered, and any ally who deals damage to this enemy is healed for 10 health.

Bramblelash.description: Snared by Maggie's thorns — damaging it feeds her Elemental Essence and it takes extra from Thornburst and Ghostlash.

Brimsteel Scabbard.description: Jarrik's next Blade of Ashes deals triple damage, can't be countered, and spawns a Cinderling on Cinders-marked foes.

Brittle Ice.description: A fragile coating of ice that leaves the bearer prone to shattering.

Burning Blood Serum.description: The bearer deals extra damage each turn, but bleeds 10 damage per stack held.

Burning Order.description: This Summer Courtesan deals triple damage this turn.

Bypass.description: This damage ignores shields, Invulnerability, and other defenses that would otherwise block it.

Call Tides.description: Zev'kir's rising tide — each stack empowers his water skills and unlocks stuns and Essence.

Capacitor Upgrade.description: Stores bonus damage for Ando's next Expel Energy, then clears when it fires.

Catalytic Nova.description: Stored power that adds damage to River Daughter's next Ripple, stacking infinitely.

Catalytic Nova Chain.description: River Daughter's next Ripple hits harder, and reusing Catalytic Nova next turn grants her Elemental Essence.

Chains of Atlantis.description: Each stack bleeds 5 Affliction damage per turn and leaves the enemy open to Abyssal Grasp's stun.

Channel Earth.description: Gaia's growing earth charge — each buildup strengthens Worldfist and Rampart's Shield and heals her minions.

Channel Vitality.description: This ally is healed 10 HP whenever one of Gaia's minions acts this turn.

Charged.description: Ando's skills are augmented and he ignores non-damage effects; using a skill Supercharges him for a stronger effect.

Chorus.description: Ayana's angelic Chorus is active, sustained while either summoned Angel lives and ending when both fall.

Chronicle Deeds.description: Invisibly watches this enemy — if it uses a new skill this turn, Tales to Tell gains 35 Shield.

Chronicle Fragments.description: Stored shield salvage worth 10 each; Keeper of Fables' skills spend it and cost less per fragment.

Cinders.description: Marked for Jarrik's flame — his skills Shatter, burn, and tax the bearer's Strategic skills.

Cinders Proc Lock.description: Once-per-turn lock so Jarrik's Cinders bonus damage and Essence trigger only once each turn.

Cloister.description: The Damage Reduction granted by Revered Daughter is doubled while this holds.

Cold and Alone.description: Frost builds each turn spent Invulnerable or Isolated, stunning at 3 stacks and drawing Winter's Bite.

Compound Eyes.description: Titania cannot be Blinded, Stunned, or have her skill costs changed.

Concealed.description: The bearer is concealed, hidden from enemy view.

Corrosive Slam.description: Charging a delayed 15 Affliction hit on the enemy team next turn — cancelled if this unit takes damage.

Curse of Darkness.description: Each turn deals 15 Affliction and a Deepening Shadows stack; failing to act spreads the curse to an ally.

Curse of Fealty.description: Deals 5 less non-Affliction damage while the Black Knight deals 5 more, and never counts as acting alongside him.

Curse of Thorns.description: Burns Maggie for Affliction each turn, but fuels her shields and thorn skills.

Cursed Gift.description: Either heals the bearer 20 HP each turn, or turns any healing they receive into Affliction damage.

Dancing Lights.description: Jarrik is ablaze — Blade of Ashes strikes every enemy and his Cinder minions ignore harmful skills.

Dazzling Lights.description: The first enemy to strike Frost-Covered Gommar has its skill costs spiked by 65 for a turn.

Dead or Alive.description: The Black Knight ignores all new harmful skills, and while enhanced redirects allies' harmful skills onto himself.

Deal: Defeat Your Enemies.description: The Hero deals more damage and ignores stuns and counters, but using a new skill burns them for Affliction.

Deal: Realize Your Potential.description: The bearer's skills cost 1 less Specific and 1 less Generic, but using a new skill self-stuns them for a turn.

Deal: Save Your Friends.description: This Hero's next Helpful skill also heals its targets 15 HP and makes them Invulnerable for a turn.

Deepening Shadows.description: Amplifies Laria's night skills — each stack adds to their healing, damage, or detonation.

Deja Vu Watch.description: A lingering sense of repetition, waiting for a past moment to recur.

Direct Energy Line.description: Saya heals 10 whenever she gains Elemental Essence, and can be healed no other way.

Disarming Pitch.description: Scratch holds Shield and reflexively marks any enemy who uses a new skill on him for his Deal skills.

Dive.description: River Daughter deals 10 piercing damage to enemies who use harmful skills, and empowers skills cast from it.

Dive Ripple.description: Next turn River Daughter's skills surge — Ripple lasts longer, Undertow hits all enemies, and River Clone costs less.

Dive River Clone.description: Next turn Ripple lingers longer, Undertow hits all enemies, and River Clone costs less.

Dive Undertow.description: River Daughter's next-turn skills are empowered — Ripple lasts longer, Undertow hits all enemies, and River Clone costs less.

Divine Ire.description: Ayana's Voice of Light deals 5 more damage per buildup, growing as enemies harm her allies.

Divinity Engine.description: Sera ignores non-damage effects while her Synthetic Skyblade shields her and drains an extra Eyes of Vengeance stack.

Drakken.description: Jarrik can no longer apply, trigger, or consume Cinders.

Drop of Moonglove.description: If the marked enemy is healed, they permanently ignore healing and burn 15 Affliction each turn.

EMG Armed.description: Armed and primed to release its stored effect.

EMG Fired.description: Internal flag tracking that the EMG has already fired.

Eagle Acted.description: Internal flag marking that Syl's Eagle has acted this turn.

Earth Pillar.description: Marked for Roland's Boulders, which launch at it, and it can suffer Affliction over time.

Echoes of Desire.description: The bearer's next skill will occur twice.

Electroblade.description: Tagged for Ando's lightning — his skills chain to you, striking, Shattering, Bypassing, and Afflicting the marked.

Endless Night.description: For two turns, every skill the allied team uses is Invisible.

Enhanced.description: Saya's skills gain bonus effects while Enhanced.

Enhanced Saya Coil.description: An empowered coil striking a random enemy for doubled damage each turn's end.

Ethereal Form.description: The Black Knight's Ghostblade pierces, and he deals 10 extra damage the turn after ignoring a skill.

Evencoin.description: The round's first killer's brand — tripling their effective Deepening Shadows and drawing extra Midnight Justice damage.

Evencoin Given.description: Holding an Evencoin, the bearer counts as having triple its actual Deepening Shadows stacks.

Execution Sentence.description: A death sentence — every skill the enemy uses burns a stack, and at zero they are instantly killed.

Exile.description: Removed from the fight — using a skill would normally end this exiled state.

Eyes of Vengeance.description: Marked for Sera's vengeance — her skills consume stacks for bonus damage, cooldown reductions, and effects.

Faustian Bargain.description: Scratch's next deal withholds its positive effect from enemies and its Triggered effect from allies.

Faustian: no-trigger.description: Internal bookkeeping lock that keeps the Faustian deal from triggering.

Final Breath.description: The first time Jarrik would die, he becomes Immortal for one turn instead.

Five Plagues.description: Each stack raises the chance Titania's Affliction damage inflicts a random plague effect.

Flames of Judgment.description: Pyrrha's judgment mounting toward execution — at 7 stacks, Judgment Day instantly kills you.

Flat Design.description: Marks an ally Character Development already aided this round, so aiding them again earns Keeper no Essence.

Forced Harmony.description: If it damages Taryn's allies, it takes double damage from her next Inspiring Thrust.

Fox Fire.description: Marked by Fate's flame; using or receiving a Harmful skill burns enemies or heals allies.

Fox's Cunning.description: Use a new skill and you catch Fox Fire; stay idle and your cooldowns are paralyzed for 2 turns.

Frost-Covered.description: Gommar's skills are enhanced, and while frost clings to him he ignores non-damage effects.

Gift Malice.description: Titania's Gift from the Fae is toggled to its harmful version.

Godly Wisdom.description: Counts enemy triggers of Voice of Light or Prayer; every third makes Ayana auto-cast Voice of Glory.

Grasping Vines.description: Vines close in — the bearer takes 15 damage next turn and is stunned if they act.

Guardian Suppressed.description: Guardian at the Gates is switched off this turn because Taryn dealt damage.

HS-112 Fury Serum.description: Anyone Dennis damages, or who damages Dennis, is Taunted for a turn.

HS-46 Ascendant Serum.description: Dennis shrugs off non-damage effects while his Big Green Fist strikes for extra damage.

HS-88 Reconstitution Serum.description: Heals Dennis 5 HP each turn, more with every stack.

Hallowed Proc Lock.description: Internal once-per-turn lock for Hallowed Footsteps' bonus damage and healing.

Hand of Michael.description: Doomed to take 30 damage next turn; using a harmful skill is Countered for 15 more.

Heavenly Parry.description: Using a Harmful skill triggers 25 Piercing damage and an Eyes of Vengeance stack; the enemy also deals 10 reduced damage next turn.

Hive Formation.description: Grants Compound Eyes and can absorb the Taunt redirect from Titania's Barbed Wit.

Hunger for Battle: Fed.description: The Black Knight deals 5 more damage per stack, lost if he ends a turn dealing none.

Hysteria Serum.description: Permanently Isolated, and takes 20 Affliction damage whenever they use a Helpful skill.

Icebite Briars.description: Maggie's hits weaken enemy damage for a turn, while her own Curse of Thorns stops hurting her.

Iced Shelf.description: Keeper of Fables and its target share a stun until any Helpful or Harmful skill breaks it for all.

Icy Shrapnel.description: Embedded shards of ice that leave the bearer wounded and exposed.

Icy Smile.description: If the marked enemy takes new damage this turn, they are stunned and the attacker gains Elemental Essence.

In Between CD.description: Marks In Between on cooldown, blocking Laria's Harmful-ignore trigger.

Inspiring Thrust.description: Allies who land a new harmful skill on this marked enemy gain Elemental Essence.

King's Saddle.description: Bjorn is stunned but soaks the damage Gommar would take, answering consumed Frost-Covered with Sovereign's Howl.

Know Your Fate.description: Ignores non-damage effects and pays no skill costs, then is killed when it expires.

Lens.description: This Prismari Ranger is aiming; allies can reflect their skills through it, amplified.

Lens Applied.description: A focusing lens is active, amplifying effects on the bearer.

Lens Target.description: Designated as the Prismari Rangers' Lens target, so their reflected and redirected skills strike this enemy.

Lens of the Deep.description: For its next two turns it takes double damage from reflected skills.

Leyline Decay Suppressed.description: Leyline Nest's cost falls when Stormchaser gains Elemental Essence instead of each turn.

Light of Raphael.description: Zephyrex holds 20 Shield and his Elegant Sweep strikes instantly.

Lightning Rod.description: Saya shocks a random enemy each turn, hitting harder as Elemental Essence energy charges the rod.

Lingering Spores.description: Ticks 5 Affliction each turn on enemies (5 healing on allies) and hastens Dennis's Serums.

Living Stone.description: Bound to Roland's stone — the bearer is shielded and healed each turn, empowering his stone skills on it.

Magnetized.description: The marked Boulder taunts all enemies, then deals double damage to whatever it strikes next turn.

Mammon's Flame.description: Each use escalates Mammon's Flame, raising its energy cost and the damage dealt to the target and Pyrrha.

Mark the Path.description: Roland's allies Bypass defenses when attacking this enemy, and Final Warning can strike it.

Marked.description: Bound by one of Scratch's Deals — triggering it feeds him Essence, letting it expire feeds you.

Mentorship.description: Gains 5 damage and 5 Damage Reduction, and gathers Elemental Essence from combat events.

Mentorship: dealt.description: Internal counter tracking damage dealt for Keeper of Fables' mentorship.

Mentorship: invuln.description: Internal flag tracking a mentorship-granted invulnerability between Keeper of Fables and his allies.

Mentorship: stunned.description: Internal flag marking that this mentored ally already earned Essence from being stunned.

Mentorship: taken.description: Internal counter tracking Mentorship damage taken.

Mindfog Serum.description: Dennis ignores stuns and counters for 3 turns, though his cooldowns are raised.

Mirage Trap: Strategic.description: Aramao will counter the first Strategic skill this enemy uses.

Mirage Trap: non-Strategic.description: Aramao is poised to counter this enemy's next non-Strategic skill.

Mooncursed.description: Strategic skills stunned, deals 5 more non-Affliction damage, and suffers 10 Affliction each turn.

Mutated Strain.description: A reversed, supercharged pathogen: it stuns first, then doubly weakens, then deals fivefold damage.

Nightcloak Candle.description: The marked ally's skills deal 5 more non-Affliction damage, and enemies who attack them are punished.

Not Today.description: For 1 turn, harmful skills aimed at this ally are reflected onto Taryn instead.

Oathbreaker Primary.description: Designates the primary target of Oathbreaker's effect.

Ominous Rumble.description: Zephyrex's storm-marked target, automatically struck by Arcadian Duet and Jolt and feeding him Essence.

Once More: Revived.description: Marks that a Once More revival has already been used.

Opposites Attract.description: Helpful skills on this enemy reflect to Ando, and damage to Ando reflects back to it.

Overclock.description: Ando loops his charge — each Supercharged skill drops him back to Charged and grants Elemental Essence.

Overwatch.description: Marked for Orbital Strike, which deals 20 Bypassing damage to all Overwatch-marked enemies.

Pain Tolerance.description: Each stack sharpens Dennis's Big Green Fist, adding 5 damage per stack.

Pain Tolerance Essence.description: Hector treats this Hero as Dennis, redirecting his Dennis skills here and skipping his minion.

Panacea Cycle.description: Counts down Ayana's cleanse cycle — every third turn she sheds all enemy effects at turn's end.

Panic Armed.description: Saya's next Stroke of Genius will detonate all her inventions for Piercing damage and Shield.

Panic Spent.description: Marks that Saya has already spent her panic bonus this battle.

Perfect Execution.description: Builds with each flawless piercing strike, sustaining Zephyrex's Perfection and his chain of executions.

Perfection.description: Zephyrex is immune to stuns and keeps Perfect Execution usable; letting it expire disables that skill.

Perfection Locked.description: Perfection is locked, preventing any further progress toward it.

Personal Magnetism.description: Saya counters this enemy's next skill; on success it loses Elemental Essence and gains a matching Magnetic Charge.

Plasma Charge.description: Saya's charged shield absorbs affliction, and damage to it grants her Elemental Essence.

Prance.description: Tracks Elemental Essence traded through Prance, spent by Summer Clique to summon Courtesans.

Prance Watch.description: For one turn, the first unit to use a new skill on Titania gains Elemental Essence.

Prayer.description: Ayana's blessing rests on this ally — if they take new damage next turn, Ayana gains Elemental Essence.

Prism Sentence.description: Stunned for two turns, taking double damage from Voice of Light (which also spreads to allies); invisible skills become visible.

Prisma Launch: Bypass.description: Internal flag that bypasses the Prisma Launch step.

Prisma Vault.description: Prisma Crimson is invulnerable for one turn behind the defensive vault.

Prisma Whirl.description: The first enemy to use a Harmful skill takes 10 Piercing damage.

Prisma Whirl Barrage.description: The bearer is caught in a whirling barrage of prismatic strikes.

Prod.description: Goaded — the enemy's next skill used on Zephyrex deals 10 more damage.

Protect Me!.description: Harmful skills used on Hector are reflected onto Dennis for the turn.

Radiant Glory.description: The hero's Stalwart Shield and Inspiring Thrust also cast Refrain on their target.

RangersAlive.description: Tracks the living Prismari Rangers; the hero falls only when all three are gone.

Reanimated.description: Revived as the Black Knight's thrall with Strategic skills permanently stunned, granting him 15 DR.

Refrain.description: On an enemy, silences their harmful skills; on an ally, heals them each time they act.

Repulse.description: Zev'kir counters the first harmful skill the bearer receives.

Rev Uses.description: Internal counter tracking Rev uses, scaling Capacitor Upgrade generation up to three.

Rising Geyser.description: Linked to other marked enemies — all new damage you receive is replicated to them.

Rising Indignation.description: Each stack cuts the cost of Gaia's Fury; at three stacks it fires automatically.

Ritual Power.description: Charges a hero's Ritual toward the threshold that unleashes its devastating effect.

Ritual Unleashed.description: Xyris gains Ritual Power on every Essence gain, cutting all cooldowns at 75.

Ritual of Agony.description: Pyrrha's Ritual gains Ritual Power from every hit and death, building toward permanently doubled damage for all units.

River Clone.description: An invisible clone counters the first harmful skill against the bearer, then triggers River Daughter's Ripple.

Sacred Grove.description: Allies heal 5 each turn until they attack; enemy attackers get marked for Gaia's Expel Intruders.

Saya Coil.description: Each active coil zaps a random enemy for 10 damage at the end of every turn.

Scan of the All-Knowing.description: Eyes of Vengeance also triggers from Strategic skills while this lasts.

Shadow Cross.description: Marked by Laria — Shadow Strike deals increased damage to this enemy until end of turn.

Shadow Rebound.description: The first harmful skill used on this ally is reflected back at its caster.

Shadow Seekers.description: New damage from Syl or her Eagle stuns the marked enemy's non-Strategic skills.

Silent Avenger.description: Ando instantly Supercharges when an ally dies, and Penance strikes through Shield as Piercing.

Singularity.description: For 2 turns, Ando casts Electroblade on enemies going Invulnerable and Flash Step on harmful attackers.

Skylance Empowered.description: Skylance is empowered, strengthening its next use.

Somersault: Prisma Launch.description: Internal flag noting a Prisma Launch somersault has fired this turn.

Somersault: Prisma Vault.description: Internal flag marking the Prisma Vault somersault state.

Somersault: Prisma Whirl.description: Flags that the Prismari Ranger's Prisma Whirl somersault is ready to react.

Somnic Watch.description: Xyris will counter this enemy's next Harmful skill, spawning a Dream Reflection that copies it.

Soulsteal.description: The bearer becomes Invulnerable for a turn at the end of each of their next three turns.

Spectral Growth.description: Maggie's damaging skills consume these stacks to heal her 5 HP each.

Spider Mine.description: An attached mine detonates for 15 damage the moment the bearer uses a new skill.

Spirit Away.description: When Laria triggers In Between, its effects also strike the marked hero — enemies first take 25 true damage.

Stalwart Shield.description: Shielded by Taryn — harmful skills against the bearer reflect back to him, and it can heal or grant invulnerability on ending.

Stonefield Stalker.description: Charges built from Earth Pillars and Boulders, spent to extend how long Roland stays Mooncursed.

Stoneform.description: Hardened to stone — Boulders launched by Strength From The Earth deal double damage.

Stun Immunity.description: Jarrik cannot be stunned or countered.

Sulphur Vent.description: Pyrrha counters the first enemy to use a skill on her, adding Fan the Flames to them.

Supercharged.description: Ando is at peak charge — his skills are fully augmented, striking all enemies and dealing bonus damage.

Sweet Torment.description: Permanently raises Maggie's non-Affliction damage by 5 per stack, gained each time she harms an ally.

Syl Acted.description: Internal flag marking that Syl has acted this turn.

TINTE Armed.description: The next lethal blow to Fate or an ally is denied, reviving them to 40 HP.

TINTE Spent.description: Internal flag marking that Fate's TINTE has already been spent.

The Nightmare Rides.description: The Black Knight is invulnerable while his Oathbreaker Strike hits every enemy, always enhanced.

The Storm Builds.description: Storm charge that Galazax's skills relocate and consume to unleash Piercing damage.

The Whimsy Engine.description: Skills misfire — any skill the bearer uses becomes a random one aimed at random targets.

This Is Not The End.description: The next time Fate or an ally would die, they instead revive at 40 HP, healing more per Fox Fire.

To Your Health!.description: For 2 turns, if this enemy uses any skill they take 15 Affliction damage and are stunned for 1 turn.

To the Skies.description: While active, Talon Rake stuns its target and Soar lasts an extra turn.

Trial of the Sands.description: For 3 turns Aramao's team Veils each turn while he counters attackers with Desert Knife.

Twisted Nightmares.description: The enemy's AOE skills are reduced to single-target.

Undertow Stun.description: Primes Undertow to stun its target next turn.

Universal Energy Conduit.description: Each stack feeds Saya's Prismatic Energy Cannon for +10 damage while channeling Elemental Essence to her allies.

Verse of Accusation.description: Until the end of Taryn's next turn, his Banner of Harmony reaches every enemy.

Voice of Glory.description: Each stack permanently extends Voice of Light and Prayer by one turn.

Voice of Light.description: Marked by Ayana's light; dealing new damage triggers her Essence gain and retribution.

Will-o'-wisp.description: Fate's team holds 10 Shield, and enemies who strike them with new Harmful skills take 10 Affliction damage.

Wind Dancer.description: The bearer moves with wind-swift, dancing grace.

Wind Step Window.description: An open window during which a Wind Step response can be triggered.

Wraith in White.description: Pyrrha ignores non-damage effects, burns the enemy team for 5 Affliction each turn, and empowers Pyrokinesis.

chargeHandled.description: Internal flag marking that Ando's charge state has already been resolved this turn.

noOverclockConvert.description: Internal flag blocking Ando's Overclock from converting his Charge state this step.
